rationale: The stock is trading at the extreme top of its daily range (95.5%) after a massive 18% intraday surge, creating a highly unfavorable risk-reward profile for a long entry due to the proximity of the high and potential mean reversion. A short entry is equally risky given the strong momentum, high relative volume (3.84x), and the fact that the price is holding above the 9-EMA, indicating buyers are still in control. With no fresh news catalyst to justify the move and limited time remaining in the session, the mechanical evidence does not support a high-probability entry in either direction.
